primitives.name: Edge Consistency Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do NOT change it to `<= 0`.** `packages/prediction-engine/src/edge-engine.ts:220` sets `if (agreement === "CONTRADICTS" || dir <= 0) decision = "PASS"`, and `:201` gives CONTRADICTS a shrink multiplier of **0**.
primitives.assumptions: Edge direction is non-positive implies no actionable signal; CONTRADICTS rows are inherently neutralized.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When agreement is CONTRADICTS or direction ≤ 0, decision defaults to PASS.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw directional disagreement to deterministic pass-state in prediction pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Decision outcome (PASS/PUBLISH/HOLD) and expected CLV value

primitives.name: Consensus Fraction Spread
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`consensusPct` on spreads is a SIDE-agreement fraction, not a line-agreement fraction.** `packages/prediction-engine/src/scoring.ts:443-448` counts `spreads.filter((s) => s < 0)`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'s_i': 'signed spread value', 'n': 'total number of books', 'consensusPct': 'dimensionless fraction'}
primitives.assumptions: Side agreement is defined by negative spread values; consensus reflects directional alignment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Only negative spreads contribute to consensus fraction; positive spreads do not.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to binary classification accuracy over side-directional predictions.
layer2.telemetry: Fraction of books agreeing on underdog side of spread

primitives.name: Publishability Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`isPublishableSpreadLine` cannot block NFL.** `scoring.ts:1071` is `if (!isBaseballSport(sportKey)) return true`.
primitives.assumptions: NFL spreads bypass publishability checks due to sport-specific logic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: NFL always returns true for publishability regardless of other criteria.

layer2.mapping: Enforces sport-specific override rules in publish layer.
layer2.telemetry: Boolean flag indicating publish readiness per sport
